HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Meta.Meta__Description: Rigid board insulation in section - a sharp zig-zag, run after run. Straight where the quilt is looped, so a board and a batt read apart in the same build-up.
HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Meta.Meta__WhySeams: Each run crosses the left and right seams half way down a stroke, never at a point of the zig-zag, and keeps 1 mm clear of the top and bottom edges. Na__LeHatch__SeamCopies paints what the next tile pushes across.

HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Identity.Identity__Note: PIR, EPS and other rigid boards, which must not be mistaken for quilt on a section.

HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.

HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.25 pt (0.0882 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

ZigZag.Glyph__Note: Points at (1,1) and (3,5); it leaves the tile at the same height it came in.

HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Placement.Place__Note: The whole tile is one glyph at the origin

HatchPattern__InsulationRigid__Bounds.Bounds__Description: How far a use may scale and turn this pattern before it stops reading as the material.
